weapon.d: Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). At the start of turn 1, grants Special cooldown count-2 to unit. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd+6 to unit during combat and deals damage = X% of unit's Spd when Special triggers (X = unit's max Special cooldown count value × 10, + 20).

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Atk.
Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Atk.

b.d: If unit initiates combat and unit's Special triggers before or during combat, grants Special cooldown count-1 after combat.
If Special triggers before or during combat, grants Special cooldown count-1 after combat.
If Special triggers before or during combat, grants Special cooldown count-2 after combat.

c.d: At start of odd-numbered turns, if unit's HP = 100%, unit can move 1 extra space. (That turn only. Does not stack.)
At start of odd-numbered turns, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, unit can move 1 extra space. (That turn only. Does not stack.)
